_how_to_edit: Each template needs a name. Allowed fields (free version): type (Playing / Listening to / Watching / Competing in), details, state, details_url, state_url, large_image, large_text, small_image, small_text. Free variables: {time} {time12} {date} {day} {session} {members} {online}. Buttons and other variables are Insane Elite only - don't use them here. Members see changes the next time they open AsylumRP Free.
